name: Referred Document Amount 1 Choice
definition: Nature of the amount and currency on a document referred to in the remittance section, typically either the original amount due/payable or the amount actually remitted for the referenced document.

DuePayableAmount.name: Due Payable Amount
DuePayableAmount.definition: Amount specified is the exact amount due and payable to the creditor.

DiscountAppliedAmount.name: Discount Applied Amount
DiscountAppliedAmount.definition: Amount of money that results from the application of an agreed discount to the amount due and payable to the creditor.

RemittedAmount.name: Remitted Amount
RemittedAmount.definition: Amount of money remitted for the referred document.

CreditNoteAmount.name: Credit Note Amount
CreditNoteAmount.definition: Amount specified for the referred document is the amount of a credit note.

TaxAmount.name: Tax Amount
TaxAmount.definition: Quantity of cash resulting from the calculation of the tax.
